name: York County, SC
findings: York County has 729 nonprofit organizations. 307 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 233 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, York County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 77 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 77 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 arts and cultural organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 8 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
